notes: Picture-book and children's-adventure sound slots. Categories: animals, weather, water, forest, home, magic, transport, city, story, time, action, creatures, play. Action cues are cartoon-safe (soft clashes, whooshes, tumbles), not gore. freesound_id and preview_url stay empty until scripts/build_sfx_catalog.py runs with FREESOUND_API_KEY. Story requests may use only these entries.
